# Imperium Romanum

> > A comprehensive resource on ancient Roman civilization, covering religious festivals, economic systems, notable figures, and cultural institutions of the Roman Republic and Empire.

Imperium Romanum provides detailed historical information about ancient Rome, including religious celebrations like the Ludi Plebeii, state finances and taxation systems, major historical figures such as Caesar, Pompey, and emperors like Diocletian and Constantine the Great, and important venues like the Circus Maximus and Circus Flaminius. The site serves both Polish and English-speaking audiences interested in Roman history.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Rome
- Roman Empire (Imperium Romanum / Cesarstwo Rzymskie)
- Roman Republic
- Religious festivals and games (Ludi)
- Jupiter worship
- Circus Maximus and Circus Flaminius
- Roman emperors (Diocletian, Constantine the Great, Titus)
- Republican leaders (Caesar, Pompey, Cicero)
- Roman economy and state budget
- Roman taxation system
- Public finances and war spoils
- Plebeian culture
- November celebrations
- Theatrical performances

## Roman Religious Festivals and Games

- [Ludi Plebeii](https://imperiumromanum.pl/en/roman-religion/roman-feasts/ludi-plebeii): Plebeian games honoring Jupiter with theatrical performances at Circus Flaminius

## Roman Economy and State Finances

- [Budżet starożytnego Rzymu](https://imperiumromanum.pl/gospodarka/budzet-starozytnego-rzymu): Roman state budget evolution from Republic through Diocletian reforms
